statusIcon.$description: One 20px icon that says a state — the single set of state icons for the whole system (2026-10-27): the leading mark of a checklist or requirement row, an Accordion row's Leading slot, a table cell, and the icon of Alert and Toast, which take it from here instead of keeping their own. Five kinds, each a fixed icon + colour pair so nobody picks check vs check_circle or green.500 vs green.600 per screen: success (check_circle), todo (radio_button_unchecked), info (info), warning (warning), error (error). success and todo are a filled and an empty circle, so a checklist reads as done / not yet at a glance. Split out of Accordion on 2026-10-21. The icon carries the state, so it needs a text equivalent: visible text next to it, or an aria-label.

size.$description: 20px — Accordion's chevron box, Alert's and Toast's icon, every icon in a 40px row.

success.$description: Icon: check_circle. Done / covered / complete / saved. Was 'done' with a bare check until 2026-10-27; `done` stays an alias in code.

todo.$description: Icon: radio_button_unchecked. Outstanding — not a problem, just not done.

info.$description: Icon: info. Neutral news — 'Registration opens Monday'.

warning.$description: Icon: warning. Needs attention before it becomes a problem — 'Two courses overlap'.

error.$description: Icon: error. Something needs fixing — a failed payment, a missing prerequisite.
